title: Interactive Sales Report
prompt:
Create a report with filters, slicers and charts.

Skills: PivotCharts, slicers and dashboards.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-13-interactive-sales-report.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
Month,Region,Product,Revenue
Jan,East,Pen,1200
Jan,West,Pen,800
Feb,East,Notebook,2200
Feb,North,Bag,4300
objective: Create a report with filters, slicers and charts.

options: A slicer or filter updates the PivotTable and connected PivotChart based on the same source.
A hidden filter changes only the chart picture, not report source data.
A slicer permanently edits raw data.

expected_output: Expected: filters update the summary and visuals consistently; KPI definitions and reporting period are shown.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: filters update the summary and visuals consistently; KPI definitions and reporting period are shown.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.

grading_config.correct_answer: A slicer or filter updates the PivotTable and connected PivotChart based on the same source.

grading_method: Server-side choice check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Choose a report control that filters a single well-defined PivotTable/source and test that all dependent visuals update as expected.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
